directoryStems.mcq-902853e657256e0104327395: An older woman with hypernatremia and water deficit cannot drink safely. She also has intravascular volume depletion that threatens cardiovascular stability. What sequence of fluid treatment matches Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-66ba0e059aa422487a69935c: An 82-year-old man develops hyponatremia after starting sertraline. Sodium is 124 mEq/L, serum osmolality is low, and the urine is concentrated. He is euvolemic without edema, orthostasis, or signs of heart failure. Renal function is stable, and thyroid and adrenal function are normal. Which mechanism best fits?
directoryStems.mcq-f4c9bcb12ff09bad7bfed6bb: An 88-year-old man is rescued after prolonged exposure to cold. Core temperature is 26°C. He is hypotensive despite initial treatment, is poorly responsive and has ventricular arrhythmias. What rewarming strategy is indicated?
directoryStems.mcq-099021fc47a1b34486d645da: An 83-year-old woman develops hyponatremia after diuretic treatment. Evaluation confirms hypovolemic hyponatremia with volume depletion, no congestion, and no life-threatening neurological symptoms. Which treatment principle matches her volume status?
directoryStems.mcq-1f4c6d00d1ad4b29ed9592a2: An older woman taking a thiazide develops hyponatremia and is hypovolemic on examination. Which fluid-management approach matches the principle described in Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-c818e8c810e2cf203e2b25c6: A patient with hypotonic hyponatremia develops seizures. What is the immediate sodium-directed treatment while the cause is investigated?
directoryStems.mcq-65fd75dea31857c1f1e96098: An older man with dementia and parkinsonism develops rigidity, fever and confusion after a dopamine-blocking drug is added. He also takes a bladder antimuscarinic and has dry skin. Which mechanisms can contribute to this rise in body temperature?
directoryStems.mcq-d143706f54594c174347793f: A 78-year-old man taking an SSRI develops hyponatremia. Urine osmolality is inappropriately high for the low serum sodium. How should this finding be interpreted according to Hazzard?

directoryStems.mcq-132a584ddad9368452ee348c: A 79-year-old man taking a diuretic presents after reduced intake. He has weight loss, orthostatic hypotension, and hyponatremia. Evaluation establishes hypovolemia without pulmonary congestion or edema. Which treatment addresses this mechanism?

Alongside evaluation and treatment of contributing causes, which sodium-directed treatment should be started according to Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-19759f76896b95f89f613959: An older adult with severe hypothermia has persistent cardiac arrhythmias after initial stabilization. Which temperature-management approach follows Hazzard?
directoryStems.mcq-97cff23d9212e0a645c0ce24: A 77-year-old nursing-home resident with moderate dementia is minimally responsive on morning rounds. Which approach targets the mechanism of this hyponatremia?

directoryStems.mcq-8e6c51556db4518aad3af8ab: An 85-year-old nursing home resident with advanced dementia and dysphagia receives thickened liquids. directoryStems.mcq-b34ae0744831be41342214bd: An 83-year-old man with mild cognitive impairment and diabetes presents with fatigue and poor oral intake. directoryStems.mcq-32a85d652e7e14aed8c2b61b: A woman with hypernatremia is hemodynamically stable and requires correction of a water deficit. Which principle should guide treatment?
directoryStems.mcq-a607490c61c3576b8a25b473: בת 86, תשושה בתפקודה וסובלת מדמנציה עם הפרעות התנהגות. מתגוררת לבדה ונעזרת במטפלת שעתיים ליום. ברקע אי ספיקת לב, יתר לחץ דם ודיכאון. מטופלת תרופתית ב- ECITRALOPAM (CIPRALEX), ASPIRIN, RAMIPRIL (TRITACE) ו- BISOPROLOL (CARDILOC). הובאה למלר"ד עקב בלבול חריף. בבדיקה גופנית- ללא סימני אגירת נוזלים. בבדיקות המעבדה: מדד ויחידות החולה ערכים תקינים Na mmol/L 126 135-146 K mmol/L 3.7 3.5-5.3 CREATININE mg/dL 0.6 0.7-1.3 BUN mg/dL 11 5-25 Osmolality mosmol/Kg בשתן 95 300-1300 Na mmol/L בשתן 13 29-145 מה הסיבה האפשרית ביותר לממצא המעבדתי?

directoryStems.mcq-28f16301f638acf0121222dd: בת 93, אובחנה עם היפותרמיה (32 מעלות צלסיוס) לאחר נפילה ושכיבה ממושכת על רצפת ביתה. מה מהבאים הוא הגורם המשמעותי ביותר להתפתחות היפותרמיה בגיל המטופלת?
directoryStems.mcq-8d25a66a3df7ec66e248a685:
בן 81 הופנה למיון לאחר שנמצא בביתו בהכרה מעורפלת. מהאנמנזה עולה כי בשבועות האחרונים התלונן על שיעול וחלה ירידה באכילה ובשתייה. ברקע: סוכרת המטופלת ב- METFORMIN ו- INSULIN ויתר לחץ דם המטופל ב- HYDROCHLOROTHIAZIDE. לא ידוע מעברו על פגיעה כלייתית.
בבדיקתו: סימני התייבשות, דופק 113, לחץ דם 80/40, 26 נשימות לדקה, חום 37.6 מעלות, משקלו 80 ק"ג.

highlightAliases.old: Core temperature below 32°C requires active core rewarming. Severe cases require intensive supportive care and ECG monitoring (p584).
highlightAliases.new: Below 32°C, start active rewarming and monitor ECG, temperature and circulation. Stable patients can receive active external rewarming with warmed fluids when indicated. Escalate to specialist core or extracorporeal rewarming for failure to rewarm, hemodynamic instability or cardiac arrest (p584; European Resuscitation Council Guidelines 2025, Special Circumstances).
Water deficit (L) = [(measured [Na] in mEq/L − 140 mEq/L) / 140 mEq] × (0.45 × body weight [kg])
